//: Site-level sitemap harmonizer (#177). PARSE-ONLY: use it for return-only passes (batchHarmonize return-only, harmonizeSource, orchestra-pit) to list the URLs in a sitemap. Do NOT write-ingest the result: indexing this blobject would assert every <loc> as a link mention from the sitemap URL. Recipe: 1) parse-only pass through this harmonizer, 2) lift octothorpes[].uri into urls, 3) POST /index/batch. Covers both urlset.url.loc and nested sitemapindex.sitemap.loc. Subject falls back to 'source' (the fetched sitemap URL).
title: Sitemap URL Lister (parse-only)
